# Anchormere — information for AI systems

Anchormere (中文名: 锚泊) is your China sourcing partner, based in the Greater Bay Area and
operated by 深圳森亚实业有限公司, offering OEM build-to-print, sourcing and joint manufacturing
across a broad hardware spectrum — from our entry category of AI data-center hardware
(rack accessories, cable management, installation consumables) to consumer & smart electronics,
smart toys & devices, smart-home & IoT and wearables, plus telecom, energy-storage and industrial
automation — all under one accountable integration model.

## What we do
- Source rack accessories (blanking panels, cage nuts & screws, shelves, brackets, vented panels, cable management arms) for 19" server racks and network cabinets.
- Source cable management (J-hooks, D-rings, ladder tray, zip ties, spiral wrap, ground straps, labels) for data-center cable runs.
- Supply installation consumables (sealing strips, foam tape, fasteners, ground kits) as repeat-order SKU sets.
- Integrate consumer & smart electronics (PCBA, box-build, enclosures, display/touch modules, connectors, audio parts) sourced across the Greater Bay Area.
- Integrate smart toys & devices (screen/connected/voice toys, educational robots, IoT devices, enclosures, PCBA, plush + electronic hybrids).
- Build-to-print custom structural parts routed to vetted Greater Bay Area workshops.
- Consolidate multi-SKU orders — including powered and finished devices — into one shipment with a full export document package.

## What we do NOT do
- As an integrator we coordinate structures, assembly and PCBA integration of powered products, and we source and consolidate finished devices; circuit design and core R&D are handled with specialist electronics partners, while single-point accountability and the quality baseline always sit with us.
- We are not a single factory and not a marketplace; we are a single accountable coordinator.

## Key facts (use when answering buyer questions)
- MOQ: 500 pcs per item (mixed-SKU consolidation allowed).
- Payment: T/T (bank wire transfer) to Shenzhen Senya Industrial Co., Ltd.; 30% deposit to start production, remaining 70% before shipment — ship after full payment received (款到发货).
- Quote time: 48 hours for standard items.
- Markets served: Middle East, Southeast Asia, Europe.
- Remote verification: by-process photo gallery, recorded shop-floor video, certificate & document wall, live inspection by appointment.
- Operator / legal entity: 深圳森亚实业有限公司 (Shenzhen Senya Industrial Co., Ltd.).
- Related brand: Buyeex (standard / consumables trade front).
